subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 6: Culture and Project – Performers around the world
outcomes: Find details about Al Haboot and Cirque du Soleil.
Plan and present a poster for a performance.

tf.s: Al Haboot is a performance from Oman.
tf.why: Yes, it is an Omani performance.

tf.s: Al Haboot is especially popular in Dhofar governorate.
tf.why: Yes, in the mountains of Oman, especially Dhofar.

tf.s: Al Haboot performers use a poem, rhythm and swords.
tf.why: Yes, those are key parts of Al Haboot.

tf.s: Cirque du Soleil comes from Canada.
tf.why: Yes, Cirque du Soleil is from Canada.

tf.s: Cirque du Soleil means Circus of the moon.
tf.why: It means Circus of the sun.

tf.s: Cirque du Soleil performs in Antarctica.
tf.why: Antarctica is the one continent where they do not perform.

tf.s: A poster for a show should give the place, dates and times.
tf.why: Yes, people need to know where and when.

tf.s: When you present, you should look at the floor, not the people.
tf.why: Look at the people listening to keep them interested.

tf.s: We use bullet points on a poster for the dates and times.
tf.why: Yes, bullet points make them easy to read.

boxes.q: Which country does Al Haboot come from?
Where is Cirque du Soleil from?
Soleil in Cirque du Soleil means ___.
boxes.why: Cirque du Soleil means Circus of the sun.

boxes.q: In which year did the Canadian circus begin?
What do Al Haboot performers carry?
boxes.why: Swords are part of Al Haboot.

boxes.q: Al Haboot is popular in the ___ of Oman.
boxes.why: It is popular in the mountains, especially Dhofar.

boxes.q: What do we put after an interesting fact on a poster?
What three details must a show poster include?
boxes.why: People need to know where and when.

boxes.q: Which continent does Cirque du Soleil NOT perform on?
boxes.why: They perform on every other continent.

boxes.q: Why should you look at the people listening?

mcq.q: Where is Al Haboot especially popular?
o: In the mountains of Oman, especially in Dhofar
mcq.why: Al Haboot is popular in Dhofar governorate.

mcq.q: What does Cirque du Soleil mean?
Which three things are part of Al Haboot?
mcq.why: Al Haboot uses a poem, rhythm and swords.

mcq.q: When did Cirque du Soleil start?
Which is a good bullet point for a show poster?
mcq.why: Bullet points give dates and times.

mcq.q: Which is the best poster title?
o: Al Haboot Show – Amazing Swords and Songs!
mcq.why: A good title is clear and exciting, with an exclamation mark.

mcq.q: Your group is presenting a poster. What should you do?
o: Speak clearly and look at the people listening.
Read very quietly from the paper.
Turn your back to the class.
Speak as fast as you can.
mcq.why: A clear voice and eye contact help your audience.

mcq.q: What is one difference between Al Haboot and Cirque du Soleil?
o: Al Haboot uses a poem and swords; Cirque du Soleil uses circus acts and costumes.
Cirque du Soleil uses swords and a poem.
mcq.why: Compare what the performers do in each show.

mcq.q: What is one way the two performances are the same?
mcq.why: Each one is a performance that entertains an audience.

mcq.q: A poster says the show is in Salalah but has no date or time. What is the problem?
o: People won't know when to go.
People won't know where to go.
It has too many bullet points.
mcq.why: A poster needs the place, dates and times.
